index: Russian ship ablaze in the Baltic

lead.deck: Two Russian missiles and a drone fell inside Poland, 35 km from European war drills. NATO calls it a “grave violation”; Tusk: an intentional provocation.
lead.headline: MISSILES OVER POLAND

stories.body: Ballistic missiles, then drones, hit rescuers in Zelenskyy's hometown Kryvyi Rih. A 7-year-old boy and a paramedic were killed; six children among the wounded.
stories.headline: TRIPLE-TAP ON KRYVYI RIH

stories.body: Ukrainian drones set the Sparta II, a sanctioned Russian cargo ship, ablaze in the Gulf of Finland — the war reaches the Baltic.
stories.headline: RUSSIAN SHIP ABLAZE

stories.body: COP31 talks in Antalya reach their final day deadlocked over fossil fuels, as countries demand a stronger climate deal.
stories.headline: CLIMATE TALKS DEADLOCKED

stories.body: Iran strikes three tankers and shows off missile launchers, while Houthis launch revenge strikes on the Saudi capital.
stories.headline: IRAN HITS 3 TANKERS

stories.body: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake strikes Peru. No deaths have been reported.
stories.headline: QUAKE HITS PERU
